articles.headline: Ronald Koeman steps down as Netherlands head coach after World Cup exit
articles.description: Ronald Koeman is out as the Netherlands head coach, following the team's exit to Morocco at the World Cup.

articles.headline: Christian Pulisic says he is fit, ready to go the distance for USMNT
articles.description: United States men's national team attacker Christian Pulisic said he is ready to go the distance in the team's World Cup round-of-32 match against Bosnia and Herzegovina on Wednesday, no matter how long the game lasts.

articles.headline: Erling Haaland 'the greatest goalscorer in the world' - Norway coach Stale Solbakken
articles.description: Norway coach Stale Solbakken described Erling Haaland as the "greatest goalscorer in the world and I wouldn't swap him for anybody."

articles.headline: Does German soccer have a talent crisis?
articles.description: Does German soccer have a talent crisis?

articles.headline: Haaland shows why he's the key to Norway's World Cup dreams
articles.description: While he has a very talented and capable supporting cast, Norway's dreams of World Cup glory rest on the shoulders, and goals, of Erling Haaland.

articles.headline: U.S. Homeland Security Secretary 'so happy' Iran made World Cup exit
articles.description: U.S. Department of Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin has said he is "so happy" that Iran are out of the World Cup.
